lines.t: Oh golly, jingle jolly, the lights are burning bright,
Crowds chase the glitter, hearts lost in the night.
They dress up the trees and call it divine,
But truth stands outside, calling out through time.
Break away from the shimmer and sound,
The Lord is not found where the idols abound.
Listen, oh people, His warning is clear—
Your hearts must awaken, for judgment draws near.
They honor the feast but forget His name,
Wrapped gifts for each other while the humble remain.
The carols are hollow, their cheer a disguise,
For truth was traded for comfort and lies.
Break away from the shimmer and sound,
The Lord is not found where the idols abound.
Listen, oh people, His warning is clear—
Your hearts must awaken, for judgment draws near.
The world celebrates what God despises,
Turning His truth into man-made prizes.
He calls through the storm, He cries through the cold,
Return to the Shepherd, leave what’s been sold.
[Final Chorus]
(Oh ) The shimmer and sound,
The Lord is not found where the idols abound.
Oh golly, jingle jolly, come fall on your knees,
Let truth be the candle that sets captives free.
